scripts.lint: npm run validate && npm run build && npm run lint:firefox
scripts.package: npm run package:chrome && npm run package:firefox
scripts.package:chrome: npm run build:chrome && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir artifacts/chrome --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts/firefox --overwrite-dest
scripts.dev:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
